intro: Your living room deserves more than just a table—it deserves a centrepiece. Acura Pro brings everyday elegance with scratch-resistant glass, soft-close hinges, and safety-focused rounded edges.

features.title: Smart storage keeps life organised and easy
features.text: Crafted from durable engineered wood for long-lasting use, this piece not only withstands daily wear but also offers hidden storage to keep your space organised and clutter-free.

features.title: Built to last through years of everyday use
features.text: Built to last, this durable engineered wood withstands everyday use, giving you furniture that stays beautiful and reliable for years to come.

features.title: Safe glass edges for peace of mind
features.text: Stay safe and stylish—scratch-resistant, smooth-edged glass enhances durability while preventing accidental bumps and injuries.

features.title: Quiet hinges for peaceful, noiseless use
features.text: No more creaks or friction to disturb your rest. Our noise-free design moves quietly with you, ensuring smooth, silent performance night after night.

features.title: UV disc adds extra strength and durability
features.text: Crafted with high-grade SS304 material, the UV disc boosts stability, giving you peace of mind with lasting strength.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
